doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Bill Fischer as arranger
summary: Brown and Laws identify Bill Fischer as arranger of McCoy Tyner albums; Laws says Fischer now has Alzheimer's.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So he had that too. He had that gospel. I think that’s one of those dimensions of greatness, is being able to embrace it all. I’m looking at – I found the aforementioned Bill: the arranger is Bill Fischer.
Because he was – because when we look at McCoy Tyner, La Leyenda de la Hora, the legend of the hour. He’s the arranger on that. So he was the one that did Fly With the Wind as well.
Yeah, I knew it was a Bill. We just talked about him last week. We have a mutual friend who lives in Pennsylvania. We were on the phone. He was telling me Bill is getting Alzheimer’s, unfortunately.
